facts.claim: TRACT, an agri-food supply chain traceability and intelligence platform backed by ADM, Cargill, Louis Dreyfus and ofi, raised a €18.6M ($21.6M) Series A led by Icos Capital with Rabo Investments participating.
Agridence acquired European traceability platform Farmer Connect to consolidate Asia and Europe compliance/traceability offerings across coffee, cocoa, rubber and palm oil.

Global agrifoodtech funding hit $16.2B in 2025, roughly flat year-over-year (-3%), with supply chain resilience and traceability emerging as a standalone investment category per AgFunder's 2026 report.
Upstream agtech startups (farm/food production/biological systems) drew $9B in 2025, up 7% year-over-year, even as deal count fell 12%, per AgFunder's 2026 Global AgriFoodTech Investment Report.

Indonesian aquaculture/agri-supply-chain-adjacent unicorn eFishery collapsed after an accounting fraud scandal; investigators found reported 2024 revenue of ~$752M vs. an actual ~$157M, denting investor trust in Southeast Asian agri supply-chain tech.

Indonesian agri supply-chain platform TaniHub's bankruptcy case progressed to trial at the Jakarta Corruption Court in 2025-2026, with its P2P lending arm TaniFund carrying a ~30% non-performing loan rate.

Koltiva's most recent disclosed funding was an undisclosed investment from Silverstrand Capital, with the Meloy Fund, Planet Rise, Development Finance Asia and Blue7 also participating, announced in November 2024; no newer 2025-2026 round was found.

TRACT, an agri-food supply chain traceability and intelligence platform, closed a €18.6M ($21.6M) Series A led by Icos Capital with participation from ADM, Cargill, Louis Dreyfus Company, Olam Food Ingredients (ofi) and Rabo Investments.

Cargill Ventures said it targets growth-stage Series A/B companies with clear strategic value to Cargill's business, spanning next-gen food and feed, sustainable/regenerative agriculture, smart midstream and digital platforms, and the 'farm of tomorrow'.

active_funds.name: Rabo Investments
active_funds.evidence: Participated as an investor in TRACT's €18.6M Series A round for agri supply chain traceability and compliance data.

facts.claim: The EU Council/Parliament revised the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) to postpone application to December 30, 2026 for large/medium operators and June 30, 2027 for micro/small operators, while simplifying due diligence requirements.

The European Commission published an EUDR simplification package on May 4, 2026, confirming the December 30, 2026 application date for large/medium companies without further delay and issuing updated guidance, FAQs, a draft delegated act on product scope, and an updated implementing act on the information system.

Indonesia raised its crude palm oil export levy to 12.5% of the CPO reference price (from 10%) in March 2026 and expects to collect Rp41.22 trillion (~$2.33B) in levies in 2026, up about 31% year-over-year, squeezing farm-gate prices for smallholders.

Indonesia's palm oil plantation fund distributed Rp2.42 trillion between January and August 2026 to replant 40,484 hectares of smallholder oil palm plantations (smallholders manage ~41% of Indonesia's total oil palm area).

RSPO's 2026 Impact Report states 20% of global palm oil production is now RSPO-certified, and the RSPO Board approved 2026 CSPO uptake targets (2% for processors/traders, 12% for consumer goods manufacturers/retailers), with Shared Responsibility policy updates due by June 30, 2026.
2,266 independent smallholders across three farmer groups in Jambi Province, Indonesia, achieved the first scaled dual RSPO and ISPO certification, covering 4,171.62 hectares, in June 2026.

ADM's VP of Sustainability Portfolio said the company wants to 'take a proactive approach to transparency, making access to ESG metrics and supply chain traceability simpler, more consistent, and more actionable' when backing traceability platform TRACT.
Barry Callebaut and Nestlé partnered on a net-zero cocoa production project in Brazil and an agroforestry project planting trees across ~30,000 acres in Côte d'Ivoire involving over 6,000 farmers.
Mondelez International expanded its Cocoa Life sustainability/traceability program in Côte d'Ivoire together with Barry Callebaut and Solidaridad.

facts.claim: Agridence (Singapore, Asia-focused agri-commodity supply chain platform) acquired Farmer Connect (Geneva, Europe-focused compliance/traceability platform) to build a unified EUDR/ESG compliance and traceability offering spanning coffee, cocoa, rubber and palm oil.

players.name: Agridence
players.evidence: Acquired European compliance/traceability platform Farmer Connect to combine Agridence's Asia presence with Farmer Connect's Europe/EUDR expertise into one supply-chain compliance platform covering coffee, cocoa, rubber and palm oil.
